investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Quillstack (developer documentation platform); Platform: Google Cloud, global external HTTP(S) load balancer (url-map docs-prod, referred to as docs-lb) in front of managed instance groups in europe-west4 and us-central1; Instance subnets: 10.164.0.0/20 (europe-west4), 10.128.0.0/20 (us-central1); Backend service: docs-web-backend; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
